resources.string: Pro activation
Manage a Pro license here. Activation does not deliver a completed automation service. Essential VPN protection and existing free features remain free.
Online only: every Pro operation must be authorized again by the server. This screen is not a saved unlock.
License not checked. Refresh or redeem a code when ready.
Activation is not configured in this build. No Pro server request will be sent. A release with an approved server is required.
Cannot reach the activation service. No Pro authorization was granted. Check your connection and try again.
No active license was confirmed. The code or license may be invalid, expired or revoked. Check with the issuer before trying again.
Activation configuration, code or server response is invalid. Access remains denied. Check the code or contact the issuer.
Too many requests. Access remains denied. Wait before trying again.
The protected installation identity cannot be read. Access remains denied; it has not been replaced. Contact support before resetting app data.
The license has expired. No Pro authorization was granted. Contact the issuer to renew.
The license has been revoked. No Pro authorization was granted. Contact the issuer.
Last online check: license active. This is a snapshot, not permission for a later operation.
Server-reported expiry: %1$s
Contacting the activation service…
Refresh license
Activation code
64 characters: lowercase a–f and 0–9.
Redeem code
Your code is cleared from this field when submitted. It is sent only to the configured activation service, bound to this installation.
Request a code via WhatsApp
Hello, I would like to ask about a KX Private VPN Pro activation code.
Opens a generic request for you to review and send. No code, credential or installation ID is included.
No approved WhatsApp contact is configured in this build. Code requests are unavailable.
No app could open the contact link. Nothing was sent.
